title: EquipmentDataStoreV1
description: Schema for Quest: Warrior Dragon equipment (weapons, armor, shields), stat bonuses, costs, sell values, and special mechanics.

defense.description: Defense power bonus (for armor and shields).

cost.description: Purchase cost in Gold (null if unpurchasable).

sold_in.description: Town locations where this item can be purchased.

found_in.description: Location name where this item is found as treasure.

found_description.description: Detailed description of how/where item is acquired.

special.description: Special effect description (e.g. HP regen per step, barrier immunity).
